exactDeployedSourceSha.explanation: The captured Studio UI exposes the deployed version tag but no backend source commit/build SHA. The release source tag is therefore used to verify version-level fee semantics; exact deployed source SHA correspondence is not claimed.

verificationMethod: Read-only git ls-remote resolved the official release tag and peeled commit. The tagged fee source was read directly from commit 6551995be232d093144f2c32b6775757a010ab3c; inspected functions include _allocation_key, _validate_sibling_duplicates, _resolve_allocation, _consume_against_allocation, and genvm_message_fee_allocation.
conclusion: The Studio-dev version evidence matches the v0.123.0-rc.6 release tag, and that release source confirms the fee semantics used by the protocol correction. The live service does not expose an exact source SHA in the available evidence.
